text.offer: So you think you can fight. The crowd pays to see blood, and my fighters are the best in Meridian: gladiators in plate, battle mages of Qor, Faren and Riija who will hold you, web you and burn you. Win a duel against one of them and I'll pay you for the show. Press the crossed swords by your map to join. A mock bout will not kill you, even here: lose, and you're carried out of the cage.
text.progress: Win a duel. Press the crossed swords by your map, and join a mock bout.
text.complete: Ha! The crowd will talk about that one for a week. Here is your purse. Come back tomorrow, and bring more blood.
